description: Adversaries may use brute force techniques to gain access to accounts by attempting many passwords.
detection: Multiple failed login attempts followed by successful authentication.

description: Adversaries send fraudulent messages to trick users into revealing credentials or executing malicious content.
detection: Suspicious emails, malicious attachments, credential harvesting attempts.

description: Adversaries encrypt data to interrupt availability and demand ransom.
detection: Mass file encryption activity, ransomware notes, abnormal file modifications.

description: Adversaries exploit vulnerabilities in internet-facing applications.
detection: Suspicious web requests, unexpected application behavior.

description: Adversaries exploit vulnerabilities to gain elevated permissions.
detection: Unexpected privilege changes, unauthorized administrator access.

description: Adversaries use remote services such as RDP or SMB for lateral movement.
detection: Unexpected remote logins, unusual RDP or SMB activity.
